summary: Iter 73 REGRESSION test of Audio-Mode after godmode refactor (VoiceModeOverlay split into useVoiceMode hook + VoiceOrb + VoiceControls; backend voice_conversation split into _ensure_voice_session/_persist_voice_turn/_cap_reply_length/_synthesize_or_cached helpers). Backend 4/4 pytest cases PASS (1 openapi probe skipped — same as iter 72). Frontend full E2E confirmed: login (Standard quick-login) → /chat → audio-mode-btn renders → click opens overlay with all 5 testids (overlay + orb + status + pause + mute + close) visible → status correctly reads 'Mikrofonzugriff verweigert' (EXPECTED in headless, NotFoundError on getUserMedia) → close button cleanly removes overlay → chat regression: 'Hallo, kurzer Regression Test' message persists in transcript area, 4 message DOM nodes present. Zero regressions vs iter 72 baseline. Functional contract preserved exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: POSITIVE: useVoiceMode hook is a clean state machine — VOICE_STATES enum, MIME feature-detect chain (webm→mp4→ogg) addresses iter72 Safari concern, MAX_EMPTY_RETRIES=3 addresses iter72 infinite-restart concern, 'empty_transcript' branch silently restarts without showing error (good UX). All 4 iter72 review comments have been addressed by this refactor.

POSITIVE: Backend _ensure_voice_session/_persist_voice_turn/_cap_reply_length/_synthesize_or_cached helpers are well-scoped, single-purpose, and readable. Credit deduction now happens AFTER transcription succeeds (line 422 — addresses iter72's #1 risk: empty-audio uploads no longer burn credits because 400 'Empty audio' / 502 'Transcription failed' / 400 'empty_transcript' all raise before check_and_deduct_credit). Excellent fix.

MINOR: useVoiceMode.js eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps appears 4 times — most are intentional (avoid recreate-loop on stoppedRef/cancelledRef), but a comment explaining each suppression would help future maintainers.

MINOR: useVoiceMode.js useEffect at line 303 has empty dep array but calls startRecording — relies on cancelledRef.current to gate. Works correctly but a code-comment 'mount-only auto-start; gated by cancelledRef' would clarify intent.
MINOR: VoiceModeOverlay.js statusLabel() rebuilds the entire dict on every render — micro-optimization could memoize via useMemo, but impact is negligible (5-key object). Not worth fixing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 pass, 1 skipped openapi probe — unchanged from iter 72)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — audio-mode-btn renders, overlay opens with all 5 testids, mic-denied status as expected in headless, close cleanly removes overlay and restores chat, regression chat send works
